messages:
Mira: Heads-up — I just saw a QuickInsights panel for customer_acme inside customer_zeta's dashboard while on the canary fleet.
Dan: Wait, you mean acme data showed up for zeta users?
Mira: Yup. Quick screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/xxxx
Alex: Which route/service handled it? env=canary or prod?
Mira: env=canary, console-v2 route. Happened during rapid org-switching in the UI.
Priya: Pulled router logs. There's a header swap on a prefetched call. snippet:
```
2026-03-21T14:12:01Z req=abc123 path=/ui/quickinsights?org=zeta user=u123 x-org-id=acme routed_to=console-v2 route_tag=canary-affinity
2026-03-21T14:12:01Z req=abc123 prefetch=MISS worker=pool-17 context_org=zeta -> cache_write owner_org=acme
```
Sam: That looks like context leakage between requests inside the prefetch worker pool. If the worker reuses connection/context and we don't clear owner_org, cache could be seeded with the previous org's data.
Mira: Repro steps I used: 1) login as zeta admin 2) open dashboard QuickInsights 3) rapidly switch org dropdown between zeta and acme 4) observe acme panel in zeta UI
Dan: Recent change: commit abc123 adjusted header fallback order in router (prefer cookie then header). Possibly the new order interacts badly with the prefetch path.
Alex: Quick check of internal API call payload we saw:
```
POST /internal/insights/prefetch
{
  "prefetch_for": "org:zeta",
  "owner_org": null,
  "user_id": "u123"
}
```
Priya: Found the race: when prefetch miss triggers background population, worker picks up request context from a previous task because we rely on thread-local context that isn't cleared on worker reuse. Old fix removed context leaks but the recent refactor reintroduced it.
Mira: :eyes: That exactly matches what I observed. Looks like the canary surfaced it again.
Sam: Short-term mitigation: rollback abc123 from canary and add a defensive scrub of headers/context at the worker entrypoint. Also add a purge for any suspicious prefetched keys tied to mismatched orgs.
Dan: Telemetry-wise we should emit a new metric: `insights.prefetch.org_mismatch` with tags {from_org,to_org} and alert if rate > 0.1% during rollouts.
observability-bot: Alert rule suggestion created: insights.prefetch.org_mismatch > 0.1% over 5m -> PagerDuty.
Priya: I'll open a PR today to (1) scrub context on worker checkout, (2) add unit + integration test simulating rapid org swaps, (3) add the metric emission.
Mira: Plan: PR by EOD, if prod reproduces we rollback immediately. If only canary, keep canary disabled until PR lands. @Sam can you coordinate the rollback and keep an eye on canary telemetry?
Sam: On it. Will prepare rollback steps and watch related metrics. I'll also run the quickstress repro on staging to confirm.
Dan: Also postmortem note: add checklist item for any routing/header fallback change — run prefetch worker pool tests.
Mira: Thanks everyone. Tagging for follow-ups: @Priya please link the PR here when ready; @Sam please update INC ticket.
observability-bot: Created incident INC-7892: "prefetch worker context leak causing cross-tenant quickinsights exposure" assigned to eng-platform.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback queued by Sam at 2026-03-21T14:20:10Z
Priya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/p/console/pull/4523 — includes scrub + tests + metric.
Mira: Will validate once PR lands. Thanks :thumbsup:
